subject: einstein-maxwell-models

sources.title: Alcubierre, Degollado and Salgado, Einstein–Maxwell system in 3+1 form and initial data for multiple charged black holes
sources.read_extent: PDF pp. 9–13: II.D and III.A–C, conformal weights, time-symmetric constraints, puncture examples and numerical caveats.
sources.classification: Classical equations and exact/approximate initial-data constructions; translate their Gaussian signs/units.

sources.title: Chruściel, Costa and Heusler, Stationary Black Holes: Uniqueness and Beyond
sources.read_extent: PDF pp. 1–5, 11–12, 25–27, 31–33, 40–42: scope, stationary uniqueness hypotheses, reduction and gauge symmetry; selected text only.
sources.classification: Established conditional classical theorems and review; its 2012 open-status comments are historical, not a 2026 status survey.

sources.title: Aretakis, Stability and Instability of Extreme Reissner–Nordström Black Hole Spacetimes for Linear Scalar Perturbations I
sources.read_extent: PDF pp. 1–3,9–13: problem, horizon regularity, energy and nondecay theorem formulations; exact spherical identity independently derived here.
sources.classification: Established linear test-scalar results on fixed extremal background; not nonlinear Einstein–Maxwell instability.

sources.title: Giorgi, The linear stability of Reissner–Nordström spacetime for small charge, v2
sources.read_extent: PDF pp. 1–4 and 45–48: Theorem 1.1 rough formulation, gauge-invariant strategy and Bondi residual gauge Lemmas 6.1.3–6.1.5. No complete 121-page proof reading claimed.
sources.classification: Established small-charge asymptotically flat coupled linear stability; detailed decay theorem deliberately not imported as an unproved logical supplier.

limitations: Only the explicit selected full-text pages were read, not all downloaded pages. Frontier-status claims beyond these theorem regimes require a new current source check.
